$comment: Input of the palette generator (TDD tokens, Palette generation PG1-PG11). Every Tier-1 color is generated from this file; edit it, never the generated Sass. Seeds are step 9, the solid fill, shared by both modes; label is the polarity of the text on that fill: light (white), dark (neutral 12 of the light axis), or contrast, where the fill is the scale's own step 12 and the label its step 1 in each mode (PG11).

surfaces.$comment: The neutral surfaces text sits on, as the default recipe resolves tokens.config.json contrast.neutralBackgrounds: canvas 1, sunken, raised, floating, subtle 2, default 3.
